# body-muscles data

This directory contains the static front/back SVG muscle definitions from
[`vulovix/body-muscles`](https://github.com/vulovix/body-muscles) commit
`15c8085ee97cb94c51f92c75224416b15f955b5c` (version 1.0.0).

The source is licensed under Apache-2.0. See `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`.
Flue renders the paths as a non-interactive training-focus diagram and owns
its catalog-name mapping in `src/media/muscle-map.mjs`.
